tool.name: Koyfin
tool.description: Koyfin is a market data and charting terminal for stocks, ETFs and macro research. A free plan includes limited financials, watchlists and dashboards. Paid plans add deeper data and portfolio tools.
features: Charts, financials and market and macro dashboards
Higher plans add custom formulas, ETF valuation and advisor reporting
tool.pricing_note: The pricing page lists Free, Plus, Premium and advisor plans. The only dollar amount in the text we captured on 11 Oct 2026 was Advisor Core at $209 per month, so individual plan prices are left blank.
